CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents.

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue pixel sets), presentation (coordinate listings and grid orientation) and a separate origin/status string for the same p0/current/n3 are all present.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition tied to the identified content's organization or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit lines identify content sets and their color attributes (red/blue) for specific p0/current/nX referents.

D.rationale: Origin/provenance fields explicitly attribute status/type (e.g. copied_prior_record, history_estimate, inherited_current) to specific content referents, distinguishing identification from status.

O.rationale: The report states grid orientation and lists coordinate arrangements for contents, describing how content is presented/organized.
